claims.text: architect-week.md records one assumed week of Đơn Hàng's architect role; on Friday the role answers requests sent during the week, each answer pointing to a rule, checklist or ADR, per 'Ai quyết định gì' of architecture-governance.md.

Five requests: Cửa hàng asks if a Catalog cache change needs an ADR; Đặt hàng picks a library in Payments the role would not pick; a developer asks for a service mesh in staging; Cửa hàng wants a search engine chosen now; Cửa hàng wants a Keycloak role for shop staff.

'Ai quyết định gì': a change inside one module or service with no contract change is decided by the person doing it through ordinary pull request review, no ADR; example: changing how Catalog reads its cache.

'Ai quyết định gì' ADR rows (contract; shop data, permissions, keys, trust boundary, e.g. Keycloak role or shop_id; new component/vendor/paid service; departing from a principle) are decided by the team lead (with product owner for paid services).
Where rules are written down and several teams share them, each decision the architect role takes for a team is one that team does not practise taking (opinion, conditioned).

claims.text: Cache question answer: no ADR needed; points to the first row of 'Ai quyết định gì' and the 'Chủ dữ liệu và nhất quán' section of backend-review-checklist.md; the change does not alter the ICatalog contract.

Library choice in Payments: decided by the person doing it via pull request review; answer: keep the team's choice, the concern written as a pull request comment, because the team pays the cost of that choice.

Service mesh in staging: team lead, by a new ADR replacing ADR 0021 if a reopen condition appeared; answer: not done, none of 0021's three reopen conditions appeared (watched table), and 'Không dùng service mesh' is in the 'Không làm' section of technical-strategy.md.

ADR 0030 chose PostgreSQL full-text search in Catalog; early search-engine request: team lead via new ADR replacing 0030; left open; review conditions (typo/synonym complaints >5% of search feedback/month, assumed; search load beyond headroom on replica) not seen.

Keycloak role for shop staff: team lead, ADR checked against threat-model.md (governance row 3, listing 'thêm role ở Keycloak' and 'thêm shop_id vào một bảng'); not the role's decision alone; the role comments when the ADR is proposed.
In the requests table, the first two rows name 'Người làm' as decider; the last three name the team lead.
architect-week.md: fewer questions sent to the role each quarter is a sign (dấu hiệu) that checklists, templates and the golden path are doing their job.

ADR 0021 names three reopen conditions: a contract demanding encryption of calls inside the cluster (if only encryption, do C first); services from many teams or languages, so each codebase doing mutual TLS, retry and per-call metrics costs more than a mesh; cross-cluster calls.
ADR 0021 option C: encrypt only the hop from the Gateway to the api (api serves HTTPS with a cert-manager certificate); defined before the excerpt.
technical-strategy.md lists 'Không dùng service mesh' under 'Không làm', with a reason and source ADR 0021.
Đơn Hàng has three teams (ADR 0025: Đặt hàng, Cửa hàng, platform); the architect role works with all three and belongs to none (assumed).

Trade-offs: one person deciding everything fits one small team without written rules; with several teams it makes them wait and become a bottleneck; pointing to rules costs keeping them current; leaving open costs watching the signal (opinion).

Deciding early on facts that do not exist yet risks a choice that must be undone; a decision left open should record the signal that would make it needed (opinion, when the decision is not needed yet).

Once several teams share written rules (principles, decision-rights table, checks), consistency comes mostly from those rules, not from one person taking every decision (opinion, contested; right when several teams share the rules).

Prereq recaps: health review treats 'Chưa thấy' as a checked result; governance table splits pull-request-only from ADR changes; care follows cost to undo; technical-strategy.md lists what the team will not do with reasons.

claims.text: Governance watched-assumptions row for ADR 0021 'Một nhóm, ba service .NET': signal = services from many teams or languages; seen at 'Service mới đề xuất bằng ADR, đội mới thành lập'; watched by the team lead.
ICatalog is Catalog's module contract.

beyond_scope: In Đơn Hàng the team lead, not the architect role, decides ADR rows of 'Ai quyết định gì'; the lesson says the role keeps to those decisions by checking requests and commenting on the ADR, matching architect-week.md line 69.
Option C of ADR 0021 is named in §5 and one what-if only, as the ADR's own first step; not re-taught.
